title: Restriction T⌞E of an integer multiplicity current to a Borel set: representation, weight, agreement and vanishing (parent steps 5–8)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, E ⊆ ℝ^P measurable, and R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity representation (IMRep) in U representing T ∈ 𝒟_n(U). Here R.Represents T means T(ω) = ∫_M θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dHⁿ for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U), with Hⁿ = μHE[n]. Then there are T′ ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and an IMRep R′ in U with R′.Represents T′, R′.carrier = M ∩ E, R′.mult = θ and R′.orient = ξ, such that: (i) R′.measure = R.measure⌞E, i.e. θHⁿ⌞(M ∩ E) = (θHⁿ⌞M)⌞E; (ii) T′(ω) = T(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ E; (iii) T′(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) whose tsupport is disjoint from E.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U E : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet E → R.Represents T → ∃ (T' : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents T' ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient ∧ R'.measure = R.measure.restrict E ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ E → T' ω = T ω) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) E → T' ω = 0
